equivalence_basis.statement: For this paper evaluation, pallet poses that differ only by a 180-degree rotation about canonical +Y are defined as equivalent.
equivalence_basis.claim_boundary: This is an evaluation convention, not evidence that every physical pallet instance was independently inspected for visual or operational symmetry.

inclusion_exclusion_rules: The equivalence applies to the pallet body's canonical geometric pose.
Only yaw angles separated by 180 degrees are equivalent; a 90-degree yaw is not equivalent because the canonical X and Z extents differ.
Cargo, straps, fixtures, and directional attachments are outside the symmetric pallet-body definition and must not be used to expand the accepted rotation set.
